source.title: Superconformal Copper Deposition in Through Silicon Vias by Suppression-Breakdown

conditions.bath: 1 mol/L CuSO4 + 0.5 mol/L H2SO4 + 1 mmol/L NaCl + 0.25-25 umol/L Tetronic 701
conditions.hydrodynamics: helicopter rotation 100 rpm (~10 cm/s at ~1 cm); ethanol prewet; 2 min -0.40 V mix
conditions.vias: annular TSV ~56 um deep (IBM Cu-seeded), 50 um pitch arrays, 1 cm Cu RDE for voltammetry

points.outcome: sub-conformal; sidewall impingement in upper half; keyhole void in lower half
passive-active sidewall transition at via midpoint; transient
brief conformal sidewall increment then quenched (delayed adsorption)

data.note: transition location varies little from -0.64 to -0.56 V at 6 umol/L TET

points.outcome: extreme bottom-up; sidewall bifurcation ~3/4 down (deeper than 6 umol/L)
BIMODAL: some vias bottom-up, others quenched; 8 and 12 min composite in their Fig 6
COMPLETE FILL (fastest published: ~15 min for 56 um deep annular TSV at 100 rpm)
transient bottom-up quenched after few um

data.measurement: passive-active transition depth vs -0.4 V prehold duration (30 s to 4 min) at 6 umol/L TET
data.result: transition shifts deeper with longer prehold; at -0.60 V short dwells give conformal lower sidewall, 4 min dwell gives bottom-up

data.measurement: passive state behavior on Cu RDE
data.result: passive j slope ~200 mV/decade; saturation above 6 umol/L TET; breakdown independent of rotation 25-400 rpm; REPASSIVATION strongly rotation-dependent (transport-limited)

notes: The named priority paper ('suppression-breakdown'). Quantifies the S-NDR operating window: breakdown ~ -0.67 V, repassivation ~ -0.59 V at 50 umol/L TET (from Menk 2019 D3066); at 25 umol/L TET full fill in 15 min. Fill outcome matrix (E x TET x t) is directly usable as qualitative validation targets for platesim feature module. Asymmetric hydrodynamic dependence (breakdown E rotation-independent, reformation rotation-dependent) is a model acceptance criterion.
